title: Wicked: Ariana Grande's Wand Skills Prove She's Glinda in Real Life - NewsBreak
text:
By Evolve Editors ,
11 minutes ago Photo Credit: @fallontonight/YouTube Ariana Grande showed off an impressive wand trick at her recent appearance on The Tonight Show Starring Jimmy Fallon . The singer and actress wowed the audience with a dangerous wand skill that she picked up while filming Wicked: For Good.
Ariana Grande blows audience away with her Wicked wand skills In the Tuesday, November 18 episode of The Tonight Show , Ariana Grande amazed host Jimmy Fallon and the audience with a wand-whirling skill. The “We Can’t Be Friends” hitmaker confirmed that fans can expect an exciting fight scene in the upcoming sequel, Wicked: For Good.
“It’s a full-on video game Mortal Kombat fight scene, and you show off some crazy wand skills,” Fallon hyped. “It’s pretty impressive,” he added. Grande then shared a tidbit about performing the wand skill during the scene.
“It got caught in my wig a few times,” the songstress revealed. Much to her surprise, Fallon brought out Glinda’s wand from behind his desk. The audience waited in anticipation as Fallon asked, “Could you do any skills? Could you do any flips? Do you remember it?”
Grande admitted to being a little rusty, saying, “Yeah, I can try. I’m a little out of practice; it’s been like three and a half years.” However, she was all game as she stood up and prepared to perform the skill. “I have to find my footing,” Grande said before warning Fallon to stand away from her so she doesn’t hurt him.
The crowd erupted in cheer as Grande twirled around the wand with lightning-fast speed. Her staff spinning skill looked straight out of a martial arts movie, stunning everyone in the audience. Fallon also cheered on with a loud “Yes!” as Grande concluded the move.
Meanwhile, fans will see Grande return to the screen as Glinda in the upcoming musical film Wicked: For Good. The movie also returns with Cynthia Erivo as Elphaba, to continue where it left off in the 2024 blockbuster hit Wicked. Wicked: For Good hits the theaters this Friday, November 21.
Originally reported by Namrata Ghosh on ComingSoon .
